top_categories.workout_context: 53ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Marly Grav. Train it until it feels boring.
At Marly Grav, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Marly Grav's South Limburg hills, Marly gravel and hollow roads forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 93 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Marly Grav's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
At mile 60 of 93, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
When someone attacks on short, steep South Limburg gravel loops, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 93 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Varied gradients on short, steep South Limburg gravel loops demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Marly Grav, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,890ft of climbing on short, steep South Limburg gravel loops does to your power file on race day.
Tempo is Marly Grav's race pace. The wattage you'll hold for 93 miles on short, steep South Limburg gravel loops. Train it until it's automatic.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Marly Grav’s 93 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Marly Grav requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on short, steep south limburg gravel loops to build confidence. Expect: south limburg hills, marly gravel and hollow roads, steep climbs and fast descents.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, G Spot, and Over Under to prepare you for 93 miles of short, steep south limburg gravel loops in Valkenburg, South Limburg, Netherlands.
